arabic_html:
فَٱذْكُرُونِىٓ أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟
لِى وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ ۞
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr on the exchange: remember Him, and He remembers you — and be grateful, never ungrateful. A trade where your small remembrance is met by His.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir on the exchange: remember Him, and He remembers you — and be grateful, never ungrateful. A trade where your small remembrance is met by His.
